title: Freshman First Semester Mid-Exam Schedule Released (2026 Academic Year)
content: The Ministry of Education in coordination with all public universities has published the harmonized freshman first semester mid-examination timetable. Natural and Social science streams commence exams across Haramaya, AAU, Jimma, Hawassa, and ASTU simultaneously.
author: Academic Commission

title: Haramaya University: Digital Library & Past Exam Repository Orientation
content: Freshman students are invited to the Main Campus Afran Kallo Hall for a briefing on accessing zero-rated e-learning modules, digital reference collections, and previous semester question archives.
author: HU Registrar

title: AAU Sidist Kilo: Remedial & Tutorial Sessions for Physics & Calculus
content: Free peer-assisted tutorial workshops for General Physics (Phys 1011) and Applied Mathematics are hosted every Saturday morning at Block 54 lecture theaters.
author: AAU Freshman Dean

title: Jimma University: Dormitory Clearance & Cafeteria Biometric Card Distribution
content: All freshman students who have completed dormitory registration can collect their smart dining meal cards at the Student Service Center, Main Campus.
author: Student Affairs Directorate
